podcast.body: Paul Williams co-wrote this "super sappy" song for The Carpenters, a stark contrast to his work as an actor and composer for the rock musical 'Phantom of the Paradise,' which is theorized to contain proto-goth and proto-death metal elements. "the co-writer of the super sappy. We've only just begun for the Carpenters invented goth music."
